name: Kurosaki Eru
source:
Kureha's classmate, Eru doesn't let people come close to him and is always aggressively hostile. Calling himself "Karura", he assists the Hotokensers' enemy, the Akuno Tezaaki. His true objectives are shrouded in mystery.

[Based on the [URL=http://www.twofive.co.jp/hotokenser/chara/eru.html]official website[/URL].]
